svg.font-family: Nunito, Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Hidden reasoning is most of the cost
svg.desc: Two bar panels. Time for ten papers: 630 seconds with thinking on and 112 seconds with it off. Tokens written: 29,905 with thinking on and 4,794 with it off. Below: 9 of 10 papers succeeded with thinking on and 10 of 10 with it off, and 18 and 20 of 30 claims were found.

g.text: Hidden reasoning is most of the cost
The same ten papers through the same tool loop, with thinking left on and then switched off.
9 of 10 papers succeeded with thinking on, 10 of 10 with it off.
Claims found: 18 of 30 with it on, 20 of 30 with it off, which is within the noise of one run each.
